reviews.t: Not natural more like dramatic effect.
reviews.x: Let the eye liner dry and place them onto the eyelid do not remove a reattach them multiple times cause the eye liner will come off use the clamp thingy to adjust then againt the lash line. THEY ARE NOT NATURAL LOOKING. They're pretty but way to long for my comfort

The lashes were very easy to use. The lashes were also made nicely. I applied to liner and placed the lashes right on my eyeliner line of my lashes. Very easy. The only issue I have is that the lashes are too long and dramatic for me. I was going for a more natural look. These are great to wear on a night out or an event. Hands down so easy to use. But they are a bit dramatic for every day wear

easy to use. beautiful packaging. easy to use. it just wasn't for me and my eyes. these lashes are a little dramatic for me particular liking, great for a night out but definitely not for me for everyday wear. i think i would have loved it if the lashes were shorter in length and width and more natural looking to wear every day.

reviews.t: It's a great product. I like it very much.
reviews.x: A friend recommended me to buy one, saying it's super easy to use, and it won't hurt your eyes, because I've used many products before, I'll have allergies, but this one is really super easy to use after I use it, and there's no allergy. Moreover, the makeup effect is very good, very comfortable, no stimulation, recommended.
These are not for everyday casual use. It’s like butterflies on your face.

Oh these are rough. They look extremely false when on, and are very clunky. The magnetic eyeliner makes it harder to apply and keep these on. Also, if you get the eyeliner in your eye, you better have an eyewash station nearby. These are almost like toy false lashes for kids to play dress up with if the eyeliner wasn’t so toxic. The lashes (3 sets) come stacked in a compact that just feels breakable and not well made. The lashes themselves are very synthetic, and not natural looking at all. I li

I love love love these mag lashes! Shipped in 2 days! Liner applies smoothly with no clumps & dries quickly. Magnetic lashes jump on your lids. Thank you makeup gawds for blessing us divas with this 2 in 1 eyeliner lash combo!! Plus they are easy to take off at night to get a good deep facial cleaning & easily reapply the very next day for a fresh new look. No more gnarled lashes for wild sleepers like me lol Perfect :) Only con: the liner does sometimes get flaky towards the middle of the day,

I was looking for an inexpensive magnetic lashes to try with waterproof liner cause i have very greasy eyelids by the end of day and a liner that won't budge... for the price this isn't that bad and the case is very cute and useful to carry around in my makeup back... these lashes are dramatic but not too dramatic for my everyday look which I love... the picture I posted is of me by the end of the day trying on the lashes all day which was 12 hours... excuse the quality of my camrea I need a new

I just purchased and received today. I will start out saying I have never used magnetic eyelashes. However I tried several times today to apply these. They absolutely did not stick and hold. The eyeliner is so black and bold and then when you apply the eyelashes it’s a double whammy. I applied didn’t like and removed several times.  They remove easy and the product removes with makeup remover no problem. If you don’t like eyeliner on your top lid you will not like these. There is no way to get a

These are easy to use, very lush looking eyelashes although I still can't seem to get them one 100% correctly but that's because I'm strange. My daughter loves to fool around and puts these on easily. All you do is put on the eyeliner and then the eyelashes fit right over the liner. So, they are easy to use and lush and last with a few uses at least. They are good value for the money and look pretty on any eye. I decided I'm not an eyelash person as I wear glasses and they always seem to drive m

[[VIDEOID:3a92fe6234dd9e5bebd0d7262f0a6c72]] What took me so long to change to magnetic lashes??? I’ve been suffering in vain all this years! This babies are amazing!!! I’m blown away! They are so easy to apply (I have ruined a several looks because of lash application) and this time it took me 5 minutes. Make sure you shake the bottle before each application. If you want a cat eye look you could use your favorite eyeliner And do your cat eye as normal THEN you apply this liquid eyeliner as clos

1ST impression review - 3 pairs of lashes, exactly the same. No variation. The tip of the liner is pretty thick. I didn't shake the bottle the 1st time, I just wanted to see if it was in deed magnetic & they seem to be. Its 9p so its not like I was giving them a fair shot since I'm about to go to sleep. The lashes are incredibly big. Not natural at all. Im not sure if im going to like these. I will update as I use this product.  NOPE. Crap. Cheap crap.

I love, love this  magnetic fake eyelashes!! They look so natural, their soft and last for a lot of uses. The magnetic eyeliner is a bit glossy, but leaves a nice look when achieving a cat look so I love it for the thickness of the eyeliner when applying it. Its very easy to use, more than the regular eyelashes you use with glue this one is the best way to apply them in my personal opinion. Great quality of lashes at a good price in a cute package!

I got these for my mom for Christmas. She tried them on and read the instructions, which said that if you got the eyeliner in your eye you should immediately go to the hospital. She still tried them on, and her eyes were burning for days afterward even though the liner did not make contact with her eye. These are cheap and seem like an okay buy, but you should really direct your money to something safer even if it's more expensive.

NOT natural at all. These are more for costume, stage or dramatic effect. Overall,  they aren't horrible and I'm sure with Halloween around the corner, someone will find some use but not for everyday,  natural look. On a positive note, the packaging is nice and exactly as advertised.

I guess they would be good if you like your eyelashes to touch the tops of your eyebrows!!!! Magnetic part works great but there is no trimming them to look remotely close to real lashes. So if you are into the total I am wearing fake lashes look these would work great for ya!!

m getting up there in years.With that,I do have the long,thick lashes I once had. I tried falsies with glue. Fail. I tried fiber lashes. Eh. But THESE!!! As long as you can draw a line with liquid eyeliner, you will have no problem wearing these. Easy to apply.Easy to remove.

I loved the fact these was very easy to apply, I am not one to wear these often, but they was not heavy or hard to use. Pretty basic common sence. I didn’t like the liner application it was alittle thicker than I’d like even with very light strolls.

The lashes are very easy to use and removes easily. The glue is super easy too. Just make sure when applying glue don't try to put lashes on quickly let the glue dry for a minute then add lashes which sticks better when done that way.

The lashes are good and you can't feel the metal pieces. The only "bad" Thing is that the liner gets pulled off by the magnets so the lashes come up and you have to put more liner on a lot. This may just be user error for me though.

I ordered it to try. I wanted to know what the hype was about magnetic eyeliner and lashes. You have to put enough of the eyeliner on in order for the lashes to stay. It's easy to use and put on it for the price.

I am not normally a lash wearer, because I always mess up the application, but I love these. Very easy to apply, they feel nice, and easy to remove also. Love the case and color, and that it has a mirror.

I know a lot of people love these eyelashes, but they were a miss for me. I really tried my best to apply them correctly, but they didn't stick well unfortunately. Such a good idea, but just not for me.
The application is super easy and sturdy but the eyelashes are so thick and so long! There is no way I would wear them! Maybe if I was in theater. 🤗 I wish I could find some that are natural looking
The quality of the product is very good, it is easy to stick on, and it is very natural and good-looking. Friends say it is nice, and the eyes are very big.I am very satisfied, will buy back.

claims.text: Many reviewers find the lashes easy to apply, especially with the magnetic eyeliner.
A common complaint is that the lashes are too long and dramatic for a natural, everyday look.
Several reviewers describe the lashes as looking unnatural or synthetic.
Some reviewers report problems with the eyeliner, including difficulty keeping lashes on and eye irritation or burning.
A few reviewers praise the product's quality, comfort, and packaging.
